title: Contents Packout & Storage Deposit, Payment Terms and Late Fee Figures
content:
Billing office schedule for Contents Packout & Storage: the self-pay deposit, the payment terms after the final invoice by funding source, and the late fee figures.

| Figure | On-Site Contents Manipulation | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | Partial Contents Packout | Full Contents Packout | High-Value Contents Packout | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deposit a self-pay customer pays before the packout or pickup, USD | 150.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 900.00 | 1500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Days after the final invoice date by which a self-pay balance is due, calendar days | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 30 |
| Days after the final invoice date by which an insurance-funded balance is due, calendar days | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Late fee on the past-due balance per monthly fee period, percent | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| Minimum late fee per monthly fee period, USD | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Grace days after the due date before the first late fee may post, calendar days | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Days after the final invoice date during which late fees are suspended on an insurance-funded job whose claim file is still awaiting carrier payment, calendar days | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Payment terms** differ by funding source: a self-pay balance is due 15 days after the final invoice date on every tier except Commercial Contents and Records Recovery, where it is due after 30 days; an insurance-funded balance is due 45 days after the final invoice date on every tier.
- **Late fee figures** are the same on every tier: 1.5 percent per monthly fee period, a minimum of 25.00 per period, 10 grace days, and a 90-day suspension window for an insurance-funded job whose claim file is still awaiting carrier payment.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A hypothetical self-pay invoice dated on the 3rd of a month with 20-day terms (not a tier figure) would fall due on the 23rd of that month.
